item.title: Expanding into tax prep? Be aware of these risks
item.description: An industry lawyer warns that RIAs often don't do enough to delineate their responsibilities and shield themselves from liability when they add tax preparation to their service offerings.

item.title: 401(k) loans act as lifeline for savers facing health and housing shocks
item.description: Most borrowers use defined contribution plan loans for essential health and housing costs rather than discretionary spending, new EBRI research found. Still, many financial advisors remain skeptical of such loans.

item.title: I left a BD to start an RIA. Here's how it's going, by the numbers
item.description: The broker-dealer veteran saw her firm's revenue model as a fair trade — even a badge of honor — before going independent.

item.title: The top tax stories of 2025 for financial advisors
item.description: President Trump's signature tax law drew the most headlines, but FP covered the "T" intersection with wealth management from many angles.

item.title: FINRA: Investors often go online for advice, not all of it bad
item.description: FINRA identifies new ways firms and investors are using technology like AI to spot changes in market sentiment and asks the industry to chime in on how finfluencers and others are using social media.

item.title: Tricolor's Excel guy failed to fix numbers in alleged fraud
item.description: Ameryn Seibold was tasked with manipulating the Excel data that the subprime auto lender regularly sent to its financiers.

item.title: JPMorgan steered Black advisors to poorer areas, suit alleges
item.description: Two former advisors accuse JPMorgan of assigning them to poorer parts of Brooklyn, New York, and allowing their White male colleagues to poach their clients.

item.title: A 'critical loss' for Raymond James indie channel: Advisor Moves
item.description: Also, DayMark Wealth Partners sells a minority stake to Constellation Wealth Capital.

item.title: How asset location fuels financial advisors' value to clients
item.description: Independent research firm Morningstar's latest study of the value of financial advice examines tax-efficient IRA asset location during the decumulation phase.

item.title: 401(k) plan advisors warm up to alts — with one exception
item.description: As ERISA rules around alternatives ease, more workplace plan advisors are warming to once-niche investments like private equity and private credit. But advisors remain skeptical of certain asset classes.
